name: xiaomi-home-auto-refresh
description: Import new Xiaomi Home devices automatically on Home Assistant

install-refresh.description: Install a notification-triggered additions-only refresh for Home Assistant
install-refresh.effects: Writes an opt-in Home Assistant package and uses a shared administrator token file. The automation previews the Xiaomi options flow before applying additions with zero removals.

notes: Requires an existing Home Assistant configuration with packages enabled and one unfiltered Xiaomi Home entry. See the package README for HAOS deployment and validation.
